exponents_equal.meaning: the two compared floating point numbers have equal exponents in the main comparison logic of le()

math_equal_diff_repr.meaning: the two compared floating point numbers are mathematically equal but have different bit representations

le_result_consistent.meaning: le() returns consistent comparison results for the mathematically equal values regardless of operand order, preserving !(a > b) == a <= b

assumptions: le() is invoked to compare the two mathematically equal values with different bit representations.
The comparison occurs within the main comparison logic of le() for numbers with equal exponents.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify which operand order produces the inconsistent result, so the direction of the inconsistency cannot be bound.

limitations: Consistency of le() results is represented as a single grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric definition of the comparison outcome.
Only the i_inconsistent_comparison impact is formalized; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
